title: Classification reference
description: A record's class in one published classification system: the system, the code, the system's licence, whether the code was checked against the system's publisher and when it was observed. A VERIFIED reference names the service that verified it and the system version it was verified against.

system.description: The classification system. iec-81346-aspect is an ISO/IEC 81346 reference designation aspect (=, -, +, %, #) as IDTA 02011 uses it; the others are the systems their names give.

code.description: The class code in that system.

version.description: The system version the code belongs to.

uri.description: The class's URI at its publisher, where it has one.

licence.description: The licence under which the system's codes and labels may be used.

resolution.description: Whether the code was checked against the system's publisher.

resolvedVia.description: The service the code was checked through, such as bSDD.

observedAt.description: The date the reference was made or last checked.

synthetic.description: True when the reference was made for an example or a test and names no real classification.

label.description: The class's label in the system, where its licence allows it to be carried.
